Testing Requirements: Unit: bandit and semgrep with vulnerable fixture. Integration: diff → static analysis → findings.
Security Requirements: Code files processed in temp directory. Temp dir cleaned after analysis.
Definition of Done: Static analysis tested with vulnerable fixtures. Human reviewer approved.
